initiatives.name: Fintecy
initiatives.tagline: A single entry point for your financial life
initiatives.description: Connect brokers and banks read-only, get FIFO realised P&L across accounts, and plan long-horizon with data you own.
initiatives.proof: Registered company with its own trademark and ICO data-protection registration — built to hold real account data, not just demo it.

initiatives.name: SHIP
initiatives.tagline: A typed knowledge graph for engineering teams
initiatives.description: Goals, decisions, and artefacts as typed nodes instead of prose. Agents read and write the graph over MCP, and every agent write carries provenance and an audit trail.
initiatives.proof: Provenance is the design constraint: each node records which agent or human wrote it, from which source, and what it superseded.

domainProof.title: One problem, every role
domainProof.subtitle: Ten years, four employers, one recurring problem: pricing non-linear risk and keeping it correct in real time. Same problem each time, with a bigger blast radius.

items.claim: In-house derivatives pricing engine — options pricing, Greeks, implied vol and the volatility smile
Portfolio margin across futures and options on index, commodity, FX and single stocks, for 400k+ investors
Real-time risk engine covering margin strategies, overnight swaps, and repos
Extended the FX desk risk calculator to Fixed Income, replacing Excel workflows with a live web platform
Greenfield risk system — mark-to-market, collateral and variation margin, Greeks and accruals
Liquidity aggregation with smart order routing and hedging algorithms
Multi-asset execution across 5,500+ instruments, regulated in 5 jurisdictions

teaching.title: Teaching & tools
teaching.subtitle: Conference talks since 2019, four Java courses taught at GeekBrains while running a division, a knowledge base on options, and a set of free calculators — because explaining a thing is how I check I still understand it.

items: Architecture and design patterns in Java — GoF, MVC, three-tier
Professional Java — generics, JDBC, concurrency, reflection, annotations
Intermediate Java — OOP, collections, Swing, networking

tools.name: Options P&L calculator
tools.description: Build any combination of options, futures and underlying, and see the exact payoff at expiry, modelled P&L before it, Greeks and breakevens.

tools.name: Dynamic hedging simulator
tools.description: Sell an option and delta-hedge it to expiry. Set the volatility you sold against the volatility the market delivers, and watch the premium leave through the hedge.

tools.name: Volatility smile
tools.description: Put in a strip of bid-ask quotes and get an implied vol for each side, a fitted smile, and the strikes the market prices clear of its own curve.

tools.name: How much is enough?
tools.description: Retirement planning across an ISA, a LISA and a pension. A thousand return paths give the chance the money lasts, and the spending it could actually support.

tools.name: UK take-home, four ways
tools.description: Employed, self-employed, own company or umbrella — the same money through each wrapper, so you can see what the structure costs rather than the band.

tools.name: Compensation comparison
tools.description: Startup, hypergrowth or enterprise: price each bet as a distribution — downside, weighted and upside — after dilution and UK tax.

notes.title: From the inside
notes.description: Options pricing, the risk systems underneath them, and the reading that shaped both — each one something I have built in production rather than read about. The pages that carry numbers run on the same model as the calculators.
